test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
A sentence is given in indirect speech. Choose the correct direct form:

He stated that he was preparing for the interview.

options.text: He said, “I prepare for the interview.”
He said, “I am preparing for the interview.”
He said, “I had prepared for the interview.”
He said, “I will prepare for the interview.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** He stated that he was preparing for the interview.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"he was preparing" becomes "I am preparing"**
 
 
• The past continuous tense "was preparing&q
